# The Case for Public AI
as a steward of high-quality, multilingual, well-documented data; as a reliable intermediary that can govern access and reuse on fair and reciprocal terms; as a contributor to smaller, domain-relevant models; and as an engine for public AI literacy. These are concrete, operational roles, grounded in the sector’s public mission. Together, they show where public institutions can make a distinctive contribution and how that contribution can correct for the current market-centric push to build European AI at any cost.

# 倡議公共 AI：文化遺產機構在 AI 時代的角色與定位
作為高品質、多語言且記錄完善之資料的託管者（steward）；作為能在公平且互惠的條款下管理存取與重複利用的可靠中介機構；作為規模較小、與特定領域相關之模型的貢獻者；以及作為提升大眾 AI 素養的引擎。這些都是具體且具操作性的角色，根植於該領域的公共使命。它們共同展示了公共機構能在哪些方面做出獨特的貢獻，以及該貢獻如何修正目前不惜一切代價、以市場為中心來建構歐洲 AI 的推進方向。
